frozen.plants: pref (L_main + lam L_2) / S_0; L_main is FarPlant's chord2 or arc density at kappa_*; L_2 the density s^4 (1-s)^alpha on a second curve; lam set so that the second set's part of sigma_22 is eta e^(i phi) sigma_22(real); c_m fitted to real sigma_0..sigma_12 minus the second set's part (M = 6, or 8 if the largest relative residual exceeds 1e-2)
frozen.grid: kind chord2, arc; curve seg(a, b) (Q = P0 + kappa_* + 0.25 (a + ib), a, b in {-1, 0, 1}, segment of length 0.3 radially inward ending at Q), low (Q = 1.69 - 0.74i, same segment), sum (P0 + the main curve); alpha = 0 or beta - 1; eta = 1e-9, 1e-8, ..., 1e-1; phi = 0, 90, 180, 270 degrees: 1584 plants
frozen.nodes: every plant at wf 1.00; wf 0.99 and 1.01 for every plant that passes (a), (b) and (c) at wf 1.00 and for the 20 plants with the smallest D at wf 1.00
frozen.a_DA2: m_DA = the largest number of the 11 DA2 members (pade_farend.members) with a zero t of Q2, 1.65 < |t| < 6, within 0.05 of one member's zero (pade_farend_diag's cluster rule); pass if m_DA <= 5
frozen.b_pade: d_P = max over k = 8, 9, 10 of the distance from REF541[wf][k] to the plant's nearest [k/k] pole (pade_geometry.pade, 120 digits); pass if d_P <= 0.03
frozen.c_twin: 15 scans per node: variants kstar, ratio, pole8, pole9, pole10 (far ends from the real series, pade_twin_end.far_ends) x classes chord, arc, smooth (pade_twin_end.end_basis), n = 23, M = 6..23; err_k = rel_k |sigma_k(real)| for every plant; pass if every scan has M_min = 23 and 0.1 <= chi_22 / chi_22(real) <= 10; d_T = max over scans of |log10(chi_22 / chi_22(real))|
frozen.reproduces: a plant reproduces the real series only if (a), (b) and (c) pass at all three nodes
frozen.closest: D = max(m_DA / 5, d_P / 0.03, d_T) per node, D_all = its max over the nodes evaluated; the closest plant is the one with the smallest D_all among those evaluated at all three nodes
frozen.C1: #672's amended C1 on every plant scan (150 against 250 digits at M_min - 1 and M_min; at M = n, chi <= 1e-30 at both); a failure is listed and the grid run exits 1
frozen.R_controls: R1: the real series' m_DA <= 5 at every node; R2: the real [k/k] poles past kappa_* within 1e-9 of REF541 and the ratio law within 1e-4 (pade_twin_end.check_ends); R3: the fast twin path gives M_min = M_lo = 23 and chi_22 within 1e-6 relative of REF684 in all 45 real scans; R4: at eta = 0 the plant's sigma_0..sigma_31 equal FarPlant's exactly, for chord2 and arc at every node
frozen.J_controls: J+: the real series judged as a plant passes (a), (b), (c) at every node; J-: the eta = 0 chord2 and arc plants fail the judge at wf 1.00, with M_min = 6 in their own class's kstar basis
frozen.gate: the grid runs only if R1-R4, J+ and J- pass
frozen.mutations: control --mutate=col (every basis' column 0 at order 20 x (1 + 1e-8)) must make R3 fail; control --mutate=judge (REF541 + 0.05, the reference chi_22 x 100, the DA2 radius 0.5) must make each of J+'s three parts fail; each exits 1
frozen.context: per plant: the frozen DA2 median (pade_farend.estimate's rule), the number of DA2 zeros within 0.17 of #541's far poles, the ratio law over k = 12..21, the second set's share of sigma_12, sigma_17, sigma_22, the largest |sigma_k / sigma_k(real) - 1| over k = 13..22, chi at 20 and 21 terms, M_lo, and the main fit's M and residual; reported, not judged
